    About Me 关于我

    I am a Researcher at Alibaba (Beijing) specializing in Ranking & Recommendation Systems and Supply Chain Optimization. My work focuses on designing and deploying robust, large-scale recommendation engines that power diverse, high-concurrency commercial ecosystems. I am deeply passionate about pushing the frontiers of Deep Learning to solve complex challenges in user intent modeling, multi-task learning, cross-domain transfer learning, and large-scale revenue optimization.

    I hold an M.S. in Computer Architecture from the Institute of Computing Technology (ICT), University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS), and a B.S. in Software Engineering from Shandong University (SDU). Beyond my core responsibilities, I am an active member of the global research community, serving as a regular Program Committee member and reviewer for premier AI and data mining conferences, including KDD, RecSys, and SIGIR. Throughout my career, I have remained committed to bridging the gap between cutting-edge algorithmic innovation and real-world industrial impact, consistently delivering measurable improvements in both user experience and business efficiency. I thrive on transforming theoretical research into scalable solutions that drive sustainable business growth and long-term competitive advantage

    我是阿里巴巴（北京）的研究员，专注于排序与推荐系统及供应链优化。我的工作聚焦于设计和部署鲁棒的大规模推荐引擎，为多样化、高并发的商业生态提供支撑。我对深度学习在用户意图建模、多任务学习、跨域迁移学习和大规模收入优化等复杂挑战中的前沿应用充满热情。

    我获得了中国科学院大学计算技术研究所（ICT, UCAS）的计算机体系结构硕士学位，以及山东大学（SDU）的软件工程学士学位。在核心工作之外，我积极参与全球学术社区，担任 KDD、RecSys、SIGIR 等顶级 AI 和数据挖掘会议的程序委员会成员和审稿人。在我的职业生涯中，我始终致力于弥合前沿算法创新与现实工业应用之间的鸿沟，持续在用户体验和商业效率方面带来可衡量的提升。
